summary:
Plan of w145 (formulation#r14) is written to plan.md.
It is a guarantees work-item with no scenario, and no deprecated scenario is retired.
skills/formulating-features/SKILL.md loses its 'talking to you' section and its Small-Change Path. The glossary-reword rules move into the formulate round's process.
Decision 1: the formulate round that finds a v_t1 row in another capability's scenario rewords it itself, through a feature-formulator, with no gate (rests on r14, 0068 and 0003).
agents/initiative-round.md: only the v_t1 clause of the formulate reply changes, to keep the overlap with w143 small.
References outside the set are left and named for the review: integrating-a-proposal (w143), checking-spec-consistency and spec-consistency r6.
No test breaks, because no test reads skill or agent body text.
